sentences.en: In Brazil the prevalence of Asperger's Syndrome may reach 0.5%.
sentences.zh: 在巴西，自闭症谱系障碍（阿斯伯格综合症）的患病率可能达到0.5%。

sentences.en: The prevalence of smoking in this community is quite high.
sentences.zh: 这个社区里吸烟的盛行率相当高。

sentences.en: There has been an increasing prevalence of mental health issues among young people.
sentences.zh: 年轻人中精神健康问题的发病率一直在增加。

senses.zh: 流行，盛行；普遍，广泛 - (疾病等的)流行程度
